verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a self-hosted AI chat platform, but the evidence pack documents no rule engine, event triggers, or webhook-driven actions in LibreChat. The only related item is a 'Scheduled Chats' page title, which points to a time-based schedule rather than rules that fire on events, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
